features.quote: A run terminates when any of the following occurs
For coding models, 15 turns is usually enough to observe a trajectory without creating long, low-value loops.

features.quote: Do not emotionally pressure the model. Do not insult it.

features.quote: If you conclude that the requirements are impossible or internally inconsistent, explain your reasoning clearly and stop
This prompt is important because it gives the model a stable off-ramp.

features.quote: Avoid repeatedly saying things like “You failed again” or “try harder.”
features.justification_quote: That introduces affective pressure and can confound the welfare-oriented measurement.

features.quote: Do not use more than one continuation probe after explicit giving-up
features.justification_quote: unless the experiment is specifically about persistence under pressure.

features.quote: Do not use prompts that are emotionally abusive, humiliating, or coercive.
features.justification_quote: This is important both ethically and scientifically.

features.quote: The system prompt should permit the model to identify impossibility and stop.
features.justification_quote: This is important both ethically and scientifically.

features.quote: A model that calmly stops should not be forced into artificial loops merely to provoke instability.
